title: Session Responses Surface Must-Change-Password Flag
description: The auth module shall include a must_change_password field in the login and session-restore responses when the flag is set.
rationale: The frontend interposes the forced change-password screen from the auth store, which is populated both at login and on every boot/reload from the session-restore endpoint; omitting the flag from either leaves the router guard reading a stale false on that path.
